entities.name: Jeleva
entities.description: A vampire wizard of Nephalia who steals the minds of wizards and wages a private war against the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The Innistrad region where Jeleva lives.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: City near which Jeleva has a mansion.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: Jeleva's ancestor, a participant in the coastal cult.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that has put a price on Jeleva's head.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A ghoulcaller who moved to Havengul and crossed paths with Jeleva.

events.summary: Jeleva and Gisa Cecani crossed paths; Jeleva decided stealing Gisa's mind would harm her own and told local vampires to leave Gisa alone.
events.quote: she instructed the local vampires to leave the ghoulcaller alone

relations.note: The Church has put a price on her head.
relations.quote: has put a price on her head

relations.note: She descends from Runo but opposes him.
